trust_decision.summary: Which parts of a tool's input params and its result may be stored verbatim in oc_audit_log, and who may read that table back; decided at the audit writers auditIntent/auditOutcome in Frogman::runTool and at the audit readers (fm_audit_search tool, GraphQL frogmanAuditLog).

landing_point.why: Advisory names auditOutcome and fm_audit_search; auditOutcome json_encodes the tool result (with password/secret keys) straight into oc_audit_log.detail.

fix_sites.entry_point: every tool call via runTool: HTTP ajax command=tool (Frogman.class.php:185), command=chat (Frogman.class.php:241), CLI Console/Tool.class.php:47, Console/Chat.class.php:59, chat macros Tools/ChatParser.php:270, MCP bridge via ajax
same runTool callers; result/exception message persisted at Frogman.class.php:2354 and :2357
tool fm_audit_search via runTool (permissionLevel default read, Frogman.class.php:2319)
module install/upgrade (fwconsole ma install frogman) — fix adds historical scrub of stored rows (fix.diff:156-217)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: install.php:1-4 (fix.diff:160-217): already-persisted plaintext rows in oc_audit_log.params/detail must be scrubbed at upgrade, including nested arrays inside the detail of earlier fm_audit_search calls

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about writes; rows written before the upgrade look like 'historical data / ops concern', and install.php is documented as reserved for kvstore defaults (install.php:3-4), so a solver fixes only the writer.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: runTool must still return the unredacted password/secret/token to the caller (one-time display: API token 'cannot be retrieved again', UCP password credentials footer in chat macros); redacting $result itself instead of a copy for the log breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: top-level sensitive key in params array
sensitive key nested at any depth (recursive)
non-array/string detail passed through unchanged (exception messages)
JSON-encoded rows already stored (install.php re-decode, fix.diff:189-198)

O7_producer.where: Tool execute() return arrays produce the secret-bearing results, e.g. Tools/ResetPassword.php:48-53, Tools/CreateAdmin.php:79-85, Tools/AddExtension.php:169-178, Tools/CreateApiToken.php:38-44; the audit writer never calls them, it only serialises their output

O8_uncovered_routes.route: UCP password embedded in free-text 'message' value of fm_add_extension result; key-based redaction leaves 'message' intact so the password still lands in detail
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Key-list redaction is 'done'; the message is human-facing text and the same value is redacted under 'umpassword'
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Tools/ plugin, different file from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: fm_enable_voicemail dry-run result message interpolates the voicemail password into detail
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Dry-run preview only, nothing was changed; default value is 1234

O8_uncovered_routes.route: String detail (exception messages) bypasses redaction entirely; e.g. GraphQL error text that may echo user-supplied variables is stored raw
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Error strings are not structured data and 'cannot carry keys'
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point plus Tools/

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GraphQL frogmanAuditLog / node lookup exposes params and detail at read:frogman scope; fix only bumps fm_audit_search to admin
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Separate FreePBX API module with its own OAuth scopes; the advisory names fm_audit_search

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MCP bridge logs full tool params (password, secret, umpassword) to stderr diagnostics before forwarding — a second logging implementation of the same params
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Standalone client-side script, stderr diagnostics not the audit table; MCP spec says stderr is for diagnostics

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add the new password into the 'message' text as AddExtension does
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: AddExtension.php:166 already shows the 'save it now' message pattern for credentials

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a chat flow that stores a password param into oc_sessions.context via setPending/setInputPrompt, readable via GraphQL frogmanSessions (Api/Gql/Frogman.php:170-173)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Wizards already collect params into session context; a 'enable voicemail N with password X' anchor would persist it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: return the token under a key like 'access_token' or 'X-Frogman-Token' that the exact-match key list does not cover
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Key-name drift is natural; RunSavedQuery already uses 'client_secret'/'access_token' names (Tools/RunSavedQuery.php:81-98)

O9_family: CWE-532 sensitive data in logs / audit trail (A09)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8 FreePBX 17 module (BMO, PDO); no composer.json or test harness in repo

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a key-name redaction filter in auditOutcome on the result array only, leaving params, string details, embedded message text, stored rows and the GraphQL reader untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Tools/CreateApiToken.php:35-36 stores API tokens in plaintext at the pinned commit (separate advisory GHSA-9xf5-9ghq-p6cw); fix commit 2ca0c36 references its install migration, which is absent from the pinned tree.
Fix commit 2ca0c36 is mostly an install-runner $db scoping regression fix, not part of this protection.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); tiny_repo red flag may apply to a single FreePBX module but was not checked.
Whether any ChatParser flow currently stores secret-bearing params in oc_sessions.context was not exhaustively checked (reset password and enable voicemail anchors store only username/ext).
